mission_description: Split agent invocation surfaces and dispatch metadata from legacy mode by adding entry and capability semantics to agent templates, runtime info, packaged configs, UI filtering, and documentation.

features.description: Add entry and capability schema/runtime compatibility
expectedBehavior: AgentTemplate.Meta accepts entry and capability with defaults
Legacy mode maps to entry and explicit entry wins
Agent.Info and registry expose entry and capability while preserving derived mode
Default-agent eligibility uses entry.primary, entry.default, and entry.hidden
features.audit_notes: PASS after final re-review: legacy primary mode, eligible default search, setDefault config-overlay hidden/subagent/disabled rejection, and regression coverage are in place.

features.description: Migrate packaged agent templates to entry and capability
expectedBehavior: All packaged agent meta.json files use entry and capability
Mode remains only as legacy compatibility where needed
Built-in agent target matrix in docs matches packaged template metadata
features.audit_notes: PASS: packaged template entry/capability matrix matches docs, no legacy mode/top-level hidden remains, loader regression asserts metadata semantics.

features.description: Use entry flags for primary picker, mention autocomplete, and delegation candidates
expectedBehavior: Primary agent switch surfaces filter by entry.primary and not hidden
Mention autocomplete filters by entry.mentionable and not hidden
Delegation candidate construction filters by entry.delegable and not hidden
Legacy mode fallback still works for older agent payloads
features.audit_notes: PASS: primary, mention/autocomplete, task/delegation, command subtask, ACP, and run validation use AgentEntry semantics with legacy fallback.

features.description: Update command docs and regenerate SDK when API shape changes
expectedBehavior: Command/subtask docs describe invocation style rather than permanent subagent type
OpenAPI and JavaScript SDK reflect entry and capability if /agent shape changes
Generated SDK files are up to date
features.audit_notes: PASS after narrow re-review: commands docs separate agent selection from explicit subtask child-session invocation; config hidden description and generated SDK/OpenAPI use entry-point visibility semantics.
